tools.name: fx_rate
tools.description: FREE. Latest Bank of Canada daily average exchange rate for a currency vs CAD (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). Pass the 3-letter ISO code.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: PRO. Convert an amount between CAD and another currency using the latest BoC daily average rate.

tools.name: fx_table
tools.description: PRO. Latest Bank of Canada daily FX rates for major currencies vs CAD.

tools.name: policy_rates
tools.description: PRO. Bank of Canada overnight target, prime rate, 5-year conventional mortgage rate and 2-year / 10-year Government of Canada bond yields.

tools.name: global_fx_rate
tools.description: FREE. Global end-of-day FX rate between any two of ~30 major currencies (e.g. USD to EUR, GBP to JPY). Source: Frankfurter / ECB reference rates.

tools.name: global_fx_convert
tools.description: PRO ($0.01/call via x402). Convert an amount between any two major currencies at the latest or a given historical end-of-day rate (date YYYY-MM-DD, back to 1999).

tools.name: global_fx_timeseries
tools.description: PRO ($0.01/call via x402). Daily end-of-day FX time series for a base currency vs up to 10 quote currencies between two dates (max 366 days).

tools.name: ecb_reference_rates
tools.description: PRO ($0.01/call via x402). Official ECB euro reference rates (~14:10 CET concertation, published ~16:00 CET) straight from the ECB Data Portal for up to 20 currencies, last 1-30 business days.
